name: team-task-manager
description: Monorepo root — deploy backend/ and frontend/ as separate Railway services (see DEPLOY-RAILWAY.md).

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix backend && npm run lint --prefix frontend
